corrected_prompt:
Premium studio claymation scene - everything sculpted from matte plasticine with refined intentional craftsmanship: subtle tool marks, controlled texture, soft rounded geometry, slight subsurface warmth, macro lens feel with shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle rim glow, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the miniature clay world. Vertical 9:16 frame. Palette (every colour in this frame): warm cream #F3E9D8, terracotta #C8553D, sage #8FA98B, deep ink #2B2A33, grey-blue #9AA3AD, heart red #D64545.

References: none attached (text to image).

Composition first (the most important rule of this picture): picture the frame cut into 20 equal horizontal bands, numbered 1 at the top edge to 20 at the bottom edge. Bands 1 to 6 are plain empty sage ground. The upper card (the post) fills bands 7 and 8 and part of band 9 only (31% to 41.5% of the frame height): it is a short, wide strip, its height only about one tenth of the frame height. The small arrow sits in the lower part of band 9 (42% to 45%), with a strip of plain ground between it and each card, touching neither card. The lower card (the page) fills band 10 and band 11 only (45.5% to 55% of the frame height), also a short, wide strip about one tenth of the frame height. Bands 12 to 20, the whole lower 45% of the frame, are plain empty sage ground with nothing on them. The cards are small in the frame: the group is not vertically centred in the frame, it sits higher than the middle. The upper card stops short of both side edges, with plain ground at 0% to 6% and 94% to 100% of the width; the lower card is narrower, its right edge at 79% of the frame width, with plain ground to its right.

Camera: seen from straight above, the lens looking straight down at the clay ground, square to the frame; macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16. Two cards stacked vertically, the post card horizontally centred and the page card left of 79% of the width, the arrow between them; the whole card area in sharp focus.

Subject and props: A flat sage #8FA98B clay ground fills the whole frame. On it lie two flat clay cards, one above the other. The upper card (the post): one flat cream #F3E9D8 clay slab with rounded corners and a thick terracotta #C8553D clay rim, one layer, from 6% to 94% of the frame width and 31% to 41.5% of the frame height. Three small clay hearts in heart red #D64545 are pressed onto the post card to the right of its second line, from 74% to 88% of the frame width and 36.5% to 40.5% of the frame height, clear of every letter. The lower card (the page): one flat grey-blue #9AA3AD clay slab with rounded corners, one layer, from 6% to 79% of the frame width and 45.5% to 55% of the frame height. Between them, one short thick terracotta #C8553D clay arrow pointing down, from 40% to 48% of the frame width and 42% to 45% of the frame height, touching neither card. From the top edge down to 30% and everywhere lower than 55% of the frame height the ground is plain and empty.

Hands: no hands visible.

Action as contact points: Both cards and the arrow lie flat on the sage clay ground; the three hearts are pressed into the post card's surface to the right of line 2; nothing else rests on the cards.

Text: heavy bold capital letters, exactly: "TIRED OF SLOW" on the post card, line 1, deep ink #2B2A33 letters, centred, at x 12% to 88%, y 32% to 36%; "MONTHS?" on the post card, line 2, deep ink #2B2A33 letters, centred, at x 32% to 68%, y 36.5% to 40.5%; "WELCOME TO" on the page card, line 1, deep ink #2B2A33 letters, centred on the card, at x 14% to 71%, y 46.5% to 50.5%; "OUR WEBSITE" on the page card, line 2, deep ink #2B2A33 letters, centred on the card, at x 12% to 73%, y 50.5% to 54.5%; nothing covers any letter. No other text anywhere.

Setting and background: a flat sage #8FA98B clay ground filling the whole frame; from the top edge to 30% and everywhere lower than 55% only plain ground. no signs, frames, posters or screens; the only writing is the quoted text.

Layout (STANDARDS 6; heights measured down from the top edge of the frame): the top 30% of the frame is plain and empty (the text hook is set at 14% to 30% in the edit); every key element sits between 30% and 55% of the frame height (captions start at 55%) and inside 6% to 94% of the width, and inside 6% to 79% of the width wherever it lies lower than 50% of the height; lower than 55% there is only the plain continuation of the surface, nothing else.

Continuity: first frame of the reel; nothing carried over.

Negatives: no logo, wordmark or real app name or app icon anywhere; no digits or numbers anywhere; no words other than the quoted ones; nothing in the top 30% of the frame (measured down from the top edge) except the plain surface; no people, no hands, no faces; no workbench, table edge or room around the clay world; no glossy CGI look, no glass reflections.

Everything in frame is real professionally sculpted matte plasticine, photographed - refined sculpting marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
